# Khan Academy + Growthbook: 5.1 Overview
Date: 2026-10-20 | Duration: 46.529998779296875m

## Summary
The discussion covered experiment operations, metrics, platform capabilities, renewal planning, and partnerships. Thread-level allocation and advanced re-randomization are supported, while phase restarts create friction and clustered analysis remains complex. Mean metrics count unexposed users as zero, with ratio workarounds available; funnel metrics provide an alternative, although continuous secondary steps are unsupported. Metric SQL editing is limited, and Git-based metric review remains a requested GrowthBook roadmap item. Platform updates include production contextual bandits, user journeys for funnel analysis, AI learnings, and MCP actions. The renewal is due in nine days, with a Friday hold scheduled for 10:00 AM Pacific and Jason added to the invite. GrowthBook also offered practitioner connections with champions from six or seven edtech companies. Sources: 08:26, 10:40, 17:04–19:25, 24:44–26:35, 31:37, 35:15, 37:41, 40:53–44:20.

## Keywords
Experimentation, AI tutoring, metric governance, thread-level randomisation, MCP server, renewal
